summary: John's 2nd great-grandfather; New York-born, died at Plymouth in 1899 leaving ten children.
bio: William Richard McAvoy was born about 1857 in New York (county unknown) and died 4 Nov 1899 in Plymouth (FS K6NQ-ZXZ). He was father of 10 children including Mary (1879), Agnes (1884), William Jr. (1886), Katherine F. (1888), Josephine (1891), Gertrude (1893), Anna K. (1895), Elizabeth (8 Dec 1897) and Claire (1899). The 1923 licence of his daughter Elizabeth calls him 'William R., deceased, b. N.Y.'. FS names his parents as Peter McAvoy and Mary Doran (no sources).
openQuestions: Where in New York was he born; were Peter McAvoy & Mary Doran his parents?
